capabilities: Classify clipped notes into existing destination folders using an AI model
Append AI summaries, tags, classification reasons, and related-note links to notes
Review uncertain classifications and retry failed organizations in a history view
Back up original text and undo completed moves
Resolve filename collisions with numbered suffixes
extras: The interface, summaries, and classification explanations are Chinese-only. Not yet available in the community directory; manual installation from GitHub releases is required. Warns that the API key is stored unencrypted in data.json and that history backups supplement rather than replace vault backups.
intentEvidence: This repository contains the Obsidian organizer only. It does not require a companion browser extension
problem: Notes saved by web clippers pile up in an inbox folder and require manual sorting, tagging, and linking to related notes.
summary: AI-powered organizer that files clipped Markdown notes into existing folders, adding summaries, tags, and related-note links with review queues and undo.
